answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A nectar ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A violet expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A prism renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 651 identities cost 3207 paid peers, 166119 tokens of stake and 37350 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
